name: Cable Kayak Row
steps: Stand facing a high pulley and take a wide overhand grip on the straight bar with arms reaching forward.
Step back slightly into an athletic stance with knees soft and core braced.
Sweep one end of the bar down beside that hip while turning your chest toward the pulling side.
Return the bar upward under control and alternate sides in a smooth paddling rhythm.
tips: Rotate through your trunk without jerking the bar.
Keep the leading arm mostly straight as it sweeps down while the opposite arm bends across.
